text:
maria (ae): Hey team — GreenCore wants to start the POC next week but legal flagged a notary requirement on their side and they want the MSA signed before any data moves. Can we fast-track the redlines and signature path?
jon (sales-eng): Ack — POC pricing is already approved. main blocker is the MSA DPA clause they changed (section 6.2). They also asked for HSM attestation in the addendum.
sarah (finance): FYI billing terms are net30 on our side; GreenCore is asking net45. That will need approval from finance but not a showstopper for POC if we get a purchase order.
lee (legal): I skimmed their redline. Notary requirement is on their side only (they want a notarized exec signature). We can accept a countersign + scanned notary deed, but prefer DocuSign + eID where available.
lee (legal): Suggested edits: replace their broad indemnity in 4.1 with our standard limited indemnity, and keep our SLA liability cap. Also, they introduced a subprocessor subclause that requires per-subprocessor notice — we should change to notice + 30-day cure.
jon (sales-eng): Can you paste the clause you want changed? I'll loop GreenCore's counsel.
lee (legal): Sure — current proposed text from them:
```
4.1 Indemnification: Customer shall indemnify Vendor for any claims arising from Customer Data or Customer use of the Service, including third-party claims without limitation.
```
Change to our wording:
```
4.1 Indemnification: Each party shall indemnify the other to the extent arising from its gross negligence or willful misconduct. Vendor's aggregate liability shall be capped at the greater of $1,000,000 or fees paid in the prior 12 months.
```
maria (ae): GreenCore's counsel wants notary before countersign. Could we offer DocuSign + notarization as an alternative?
sarah (finance): If they require net45 we need PO before start and approval from legal for revenue recognition impact. If they provide PO that references the signed orderform we can proceed.
jon (sales-eng): I'll propose two flows to them: 1) DocuSign + eID (faster), 2) Physical notarization + scanned docs (slower). If they pick option 2 we should set POC start a week later.
lee (legal): Agreed. I'll draft a short clause to allow either "electronically notarized signature" or "physical notarization with scanned certificate" and limit the notary requirement to the customer exec only.
esign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope 0a9f created for GreenCore MSA (docs: MSA_v3_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC.pdf). Status: awaiting signer (GreenCore exec).
maria (ae): Great — Jon, can you confirm with GreenCore counsel that we're okay with the indemnity/lcap edits and the two notarization options? I'll request PO in parallel.
jon (sales-eng): On it. Pinged counsel: "sending proposed compromise now, pls confirm notarization preference (eID vs physical)." :email:
lee (legal): I'll prep a tracked change doc for MSA + a one-paragraph orderform addendum clarifying POC scope/price/net terms.
sarah (finance): If they accept net30 on the PO then finance will greenlight immediate provisioning. If not, provisioning after PO receipt + final legal sign-off.
maria (ae): Thanks all — flagging as urgent. If we get green light today we can still start next Tue. :thumbsup:
jon (sales-eng): Counsel replied: prefer physical notary. They asked if we can accept scanned notary w/ apostille later — I said yes pending legal OK.
lee (legal): OK to accept scanned notary initially, with original mailed within 30 days. I'll add that clause.
maria (ae): Awesome. I'll update the prospect with the timeline and ask for PO and which notarization route.
jon (sales-eng): moving to DM to coordinate signers and verify billing contact.
lee (legal): Filing: MSA_redline_tracker -> updated, tagging @sarah for billing terms.
sarah (finance): Got it. Watching for PO.
maria (ae): closing thread — will post status once PO or signed doc received.
